copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可通过 Microsoft Teams 收发消息，支持团队频道、群聊和私信。设置过程会复制适配器、注册依赖，并引导完成 bot 创建与安装。
howto.when: 当你说“添加 Teams 集成”“配置 Teams 渠道”等，或要求把 Claude 接入 Microsoft Teams 时触发。

say.text: 帮我添加 Microsoft Teams 集成
say.note: 开始复制适配器并执行 Teams 设置流程

say.text: 在 Teams 里给我发一条测试消息
say.note: 用于验证 bot 是否已正确安装并链接

say.text: 检查 Teams 凭据是否已配置
say.note: 会检查 .env 中的 Teams 相关凭据是否存在

howto.what_en: After install, Claude gains Microsoft Teams support via the Chat SDK bridge—chat in team channels, group chats, and DMs. The skill copies the adapter, registers it, installs a pinned dependency, and guides bot creation/install via the Teams CLI.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add Teams integration, configure a Teams channel, or connect Claude to Microsoft Teams.

say_en.note: Starts the adapter copy and Teams setup flow.

say_en.text: Send me a test message in Teams
say_en.note: Verifies the bot is installed and linked.

say_en.text: Check if Teams credentials are configured
